# Noto Sans KR

Source: [official Noto CJK repository, Sans2.004 release](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/Sans2.004).
Font: `Sans/SubsetOTF/KR/NotoSansKR-Regular.otf`, downloaded unchanged on 2026-09-22.
Noto Sans KR is part of the Google / Adobe Noto CJK font project.
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; the original release [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) is included.
The original font binary retains its embedded copyright and naming metadata.

Project path: `Assets/Resources/Fonts/NotoSansKR/NotoSansKR-Regular.otf`.
Used for every solo-defense UI label, including Korean help text. No font modification or OS installation.
